WITH region_counts AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count FROM region_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS average_count FROM region_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(r.cnt),
  AVG(CAST(r.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_count),
  AVG(r.cnt - av.average_count)
FROM region_counts AS r
JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL
JOIN averages AS av ON av.average_count IS NOT NULL
WHERE r.cnt > av.average_count
